create_logging_handler: create a LiteLLM Logging handler instance to capture LLM API call details including input, output, and cost
build_standard_logging_payload: build a StandardLoggingPayload object containing model, metadata, usage, cost, and response details for a successful or failed LLM call
initialize_custom_logger: initialize a custom logger compatible class such as langfuse, sentry, datadog, or prometheus for LLM request logging
set_global_callbacks: set global callback integrations like sentry, slack, langfuse, or s3 for automatic LLM request and response logging
extract_usage_from_response: extract token usage (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens) from an LLM response object
